description: Budgets of a change and of the gate (D-008, D-022, D-069 item 14).

budgets.baseline_path.description: The committed baseline computed from the event log by `scripts/budgets baseline --write` (contracts/budgets/baseline.v1.json). Never hand-written.

budgets.min_samples.description: Fewest measurements a metric needs before the baseline is written or a verdict can fail; below it the state is no_data and nothing is invented.

budgets.percent_whole.description: Percent that makes the whole: a tolerance of budgets.regression_tolerance_percent grows a baseline by tolerance / this.

budgets.pr_changed_lines.description: Changed lines of a PR, tests and generated files excluded, above which structure-check warns.

budgets.pr_commits_max.description: Most items of a PR's commit plan; 0, the default, sets no maximum (D-307: a PR is split by its content, never by a counter).

budgets.pr_commits_min.description: Fewest items of a PR's commit plan.

budgets.regression_tolerance_percent.description: Percent a measured p95 may exceed its baseline before the gate fails (D-069 item 14). Applies to the battery per unit (limit: battery.unit_time_limit), the web bundle and the page latency. A tolerance only tightens.

budgets.tighten_only.description: The registry entries that are budgets and only tighten: a max entry may not grow and a min entry may not shrink against the base unless its x-source gains a decision recorded in docs/domain/DECISIONS.md. The measured baseline may not grow beyond budgets.regression_tolerance_percent without the same decision on its metric's entry.

budgets.window_samples.description: Newest measurements per metric and subject the baseline and the check fold into one p95.
